Cocktail of the Week

A fresh JNC cocktail every week—complete with the recipe, the vibe, the episode, and just enough chaos to make it memorable.

Featured Recipe

The Fresh Watermelon

The vibe: Equal parts 99 Watermelons and Dr Pepper that somehow magically tastes like fresh watermelon—bright, fizzy, ridiculous, and dangerously easy.

Ingredients
  • 99 Watermelons1 part
  • Dr Pepper1 part
  • IceFill glass
  • Watermelon garnishOptional
Method

Fill a rocks glass with ice. Pour in the 99 Watermelons, followed by an equal amount of Dr Pepper. Give it a gentle stir, garnish if desired, and serve.

More Than a Recipe

Behind the Drink

Connect each weekly cocktail to the show where it appeared, so visitors can watch the segment instead of landing on a dead-end recipe graphic.

See It Mixed on JNC Open the featured episode on YouTube
“The drink that has no business tasting this much like fresh watermelon.”

The Fresh Watermelon is pure JNC science: equal parts 99 Watermelons and Dr Pepper over ice. Somehow, against all reasonable expectations, the combination lands like a crisp fresh watermelon cocktail.

This one is quick, fun, and built for the kind of on-air discovery that makes Cocktail of the Week feel like a little experiment behind the bar.
